expmap_flat_torus: compute the exponential map on a flat torus by adding tangent vector and wrapping modulo 2pi
logmap_flat_torus: compute the logarithmic map between two points on a flat torus using atan2 of sin and cos differences
projx_flat_torus: project a tensor onto the flat torus manifold by wrapping values modulo 2pi
random_uniform_flat_torus: generate uniformly random points on a flat torus manifold scaled to the 0 to 2pi range
uniform_logprob_flat_torus: compute the uniform log probability density for points on a flat torus based on manifold dimension
